# requireValidSheetId

<link-summary>Returns the value as a sheet id, or throws.</link-summary>

<web-summary>requireValidSheetId() — Returns the value as a sheet id, or throws. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>appsscript/sheet</code> · Since: 1.11.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function requireValidSheetId(
  value: unknown,
  message: string = "Expected a valid sheet id."
): number;
```

Apps Script numbers its sheets from zero, so a sheet id is a non-negative safe integer — the same rule `isCountable` applies. The id of the first sheet in a spreadsheet is `0`.

`isX` and `nonX` answer a question and never interrupt control flow; `requireX` and `requireNonX` hand the value back or throw. The scheme is explained in [](validation-conventions.md).

## Parameters

| Parameter                                               | Type      | Description                                                   |
| :------------------------------------------------------ | :-------- | :------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `value`                                                 | `unknown` | The value to validate.                                        |
| `message` _(optional)_ `= "Expected a valid sheet id."` | `string`  | The message of the exception. A default is used when omitted. |

## Returns

`number` — the same value, typed as a sheet id.

## Throws

| Exception                  | Condition                    |
| :------------------------- | :--------------------------- |
| `IllegalArgumentException` | the value is not a sheet id. |

## Examples

### What passes and what does not

```javascript
requireValidSheetId(0); // => 0
requireValidSheetId(1234567890); // => 1234567890
requireValidSheetId(-1); // throws IllegalArgumentException
requireValidSheetId(1.5); // throws IllegalArgumentException
```
